# SaveEditor.Online — Full Documentation for LLMs

> Free, browser-based, privacy-first save file editor for games.
> All file processing happens client-side via JavaScript/WebAssembly — nothing is uploaded.

## Site Identity

- **Name**: SaveEditor.Online (also referenced as SaveEditor.Online)
- **URL**: https://saveeditor.top
- **Type**: Free web application (SoftwareApplication)
- **Category**: UtilitiesApplication
- **Operating System**: Web Browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- **Pricing**: Free, no registration required
- **File size limit**: 50 MB per file
- **Privacy**: All file processing happens locally in the user's browser

## Supported Game Engines & Formats

### RPG Maker MV/MZ
- **File extensions**: `.rpgsave`, `.rmmzsave`
- **Format**: Base64-encoded JSON
- **Editor URL**: /editor/rpg-maker-mv/
- **Capabilities**: Full read/write. Edit gold, items, stats, switches, variables, party data.
- **Save location (Windows)**: `Game folder/www/save` or `Game folder/save`
- **Save location (Mac)**: `Game.app/Contents/Resources/app.nw/save`
- **Popular games**: Stardew Valley (modded RPG Maker), Omori, OneShot, To the Moon

### Unity PlayerPrefs
- **File extensions**: `.xml`, `.plist`
- **Format**: XML (Windows), Property List (macOS)
- **Editor URL**: /editor/unity/
- **Capabilities**: Full read/write for XML/plist PlayerPrefs. Binary PlayerPrefs are read-only.
- **Save location (Windows)**: `%APPDATA%/../LocalLow/[CompanyName]/[GameName]/`
- **Save location (Mac)**: `~/Library/Preferences/unity.[CompanyName].[GameName].plist`
- **Popular games**: Hollow Knight, Vampire Survivors, Cult of the Lamb, Cuphead

### Ren'Py
- **File extensions**: `.save`, `persistent`
- **Format**: Python pickle (serialized)
- **Editor URL**: /editor/renpy/
- **Capabilities**: View all data. Editing is experimental — simple fields can be modified.
- **Save location (Windows)**: `%APPDATA%/RenPy/[GameName]/`
- **Save location (Mac)**: `~/Library/RenPy/[GameName]/`
- **Popular games**: Doki Doki Literature Club, Katawa Shoujo, The Arcana

### Unreal Engine
- **File extensions**: `.sav`
- **Format**: Binary GVAS (Generic Versioned Arbitrary Serialization)
- **Editor URL**: /editor/unreal/
- **Capabilities**: Standard GVAS: full read/write. Compressed (gzip/zlib) GVAS: read/write with safe recompression. Custom containers/encrypted: read-only.
- **Save location**: Varies by game, typically `%LOCALAPPDATA%/[GameName]/Saved/SaveGames/`
- **Popular games**: Palworld, Satisfactory, Deep Rock Galactic, Astroneer

### GameMaker
- **File extensions**: `.ini`, `.json`
- **Format**: INI key-value or JSON
- **Editor URL**: /editor/gamemaker/
- **Capabilities**: Full read/write.
- **Save location**: Varies, often `%LOCALAPPDATA%/[GameName]/`
- **Popular games**: Undertale, Deltarune, Hyper Light Drifter, Nuclear Throne

### NaniNovel
- **File extensions**: `.nson`
- **Format**: Custom JSON-like (NSON)
- **Editor URL**: /editor/naninovel/
- **Capabilities**: Full read/write (unencrypted saves). Encrypted saves are detected but unsupported.
- **Popular games**: Various visual novels built on NaniNovel Unity framework

## Technical Architecture

- **Framework**: Astro (SSG with Cloudflare adapter)
- **Frontend**: React components, Tailwind CSS
- **Parsing**: Client-side JavaScript/WebAssembly
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Pages
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics (consent-gated)
- **Ads**: Google AdSense (consent-gated)
- **Security**: Content Security Policy (CSP), all processing client-side

## How It Works

1. **Upload**: User drags & drops or selects a save file
2. **Auto-Detect**: Engine/format is auto-detected from file content
3. **Parse**: File is parsed client-side (no server upload)
4. **Edit**: Visual tree editor for modifying values (gold, stats, items, switches, etc.)
5. **Download**: Modified save is downloaded and replaces the original
